content_metadata.description: In this video, Adanna shares her experiences and insights about taking the GRE as part of her journey towards PA school. From addressing negative comments to discussing her study strategies and GRE scores, Adanna is transparent and motivating. She aims to help others by offering tips and encouraging them to persist in their educational pursuits.
